results.title: Workflow kernel — Specification and Task execution
results.summary: One deterministic workflow core (the neutral @nevo/workflow coordinator, with the SpecFlow adapter in the Engine) drives both a Specification and each of its Tasks. Entry points only select the subject. Workflows, agent archetypes (preferred provider and a model per provider) and task types are project definitions. A step declares which executor classes may do it, and every attempt records its actor. A Task is a resource (tasks/index.yaml, task.yaml, task.md) with its own type, workflow and preparation status (draft, ready, on-hold, cancelled), changed only by explicit decisions, a declared approval effect or its own escalation; its run is created at its first start. The Engine decides continuations; anything it cannot carry out is attention for the owner, derived from the state on every inspection and never stored. Runs live in the Specification's `.execution/` folder; only the change journal is local. The writes are committed like the Specification's documents (the document commit policy, queue and ledger); with auto-commit off a step's finish commits them, and a Close takes what is left.

results.title: Workflow kernel — Specification and Task execution
results.summary: One deterministic workflow core (the neutral @nevo/workflow coordinator, with the SpecFlow adapter in the Engine) drives both a Specification and each of its Tasks. Entry points only select the subject. Workflows, agent archetypes (preferred provider and a model per provider) and task types are project definitions. A step declares which executor classes may do it, and every attempt records its actor. A Task is a resource (tasks/index.yaml, task.yaml, task.md) with its own type, workflow and preparation status (draft, ready, on-hold, cancelled), changed only by explicit decisions, a declared approval effect or its own escalation; its run is created at its first start. The Engine decides continuations; anything it cannot carry out is attention for the owner, derived from the state on every inspection and never stored. Runs live in the Specification's `.execution/` folder; only the change journal is local. The writes are committed like the Specification's documents (the document commit policy, queue and ledger); with auto-commit off a step's finish commits them, and a Close takes what is left.

results.summary: Amended by ADR 0018 (automatic commit is opt-in, default off).
